question: Mubvunzo
defaultDirections: Sarudza mhinduro yaunofunga kuti inopindura mubvunzo. Kana wapedza, dzvanya {checkAnswer}. Uchawana mhinduro inoratidza kana mhinduro yako yakarurama uye zvekuita zvinotevera.
relatedContentDescription: Izvi zvinogadzira nzvimbo yakapetwa yezvinoenderana nemubvunzo uyu uye zvinogara zvichiratidzwa
hintDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akakanganisa mhinduro
evidenceDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akarurama mhinduro
numericDirections: Nyora nhamba. Chiyero chinoratidzwa kwauri. Kana wapedza, sarudza {checkAnswer}.
withinPercent: Mhinduro dziri mukati me{tolerance}% yehuwandu chaihwo dzinoverengwa.
withinAbsolute: Mhinduro dziri mukati me{tolerance} yehuwandu chaihwo dzinoverengwa.
formulaHelp: Nhamba, kana fomura inoshandisa zvinoshanduka zviri pazasi, semuenzaniso d / (t / 60). Fomura dzinogona kushandisa + - * / ^, mabhuraketi, sqrt() ne abs().
tokensHelp: Ratidza chinoshanduka mumubvunzo nekunyora zita racho mumabhuraketi akakombama, semuenzaniso {d}.
keyProblem: Izvi hazvisati zvagona kuverengwa. Tarisa kuti zita rese mufomura chinoshanduka.
